newsitem.title: USA: Evenflo & Spalding hire marketing executive.
newsitem.headline: Evenflo & Spalding hire marketing executive.

text.p: Evenflo & Spalding Holdings Corp said Friday Kevin Martin will join the company in the newly created position of president and chief operating officer, effective September 1.
Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co, the company's majority stockholder, said: "We are pleased Evenflo & Spalding is adding a seasoned marketing executive of Kevin Martin's caliber.

Martin joins the company from Brach & Brock Confections, where he served as president and chief executive officer, Evenflo and Spalding said. The company makes consumer products serving the golf, sporting goods, infant and juvenile markets.
